fullPassage:
주어진 글: Believe it or not, trees in Melbourne, Australia receive emails like this all the time. How is it possible that trees have email addresses?

(A) In 2012, the city government announced its Urban Forest Strategy plan. It set the ambitious goal of planting more than 3,000 trees every year for the next twenty years. The plan also involved the creation of an online map called the Urban Forest Visual.

(B) The story behind these emails begins with Melbourne's Urban Forest Strategy plan, a response to Australia's millennium drought. This drought lasted from the late 1990s to 2010. By the time it ended, 40 percent of the city's 77,000 trees were in a state of declining health.

(C) Something had to be done to deal with the loss of Melbourne's trees.

questions.passage: Believe it or not, trees in Melbourne, Australia <u>ⓐ receive</u> emails like this all the time. The story behind these emails <u>ⓑ begins</u> with Melbourne's Urban Forest Strategy plan, a response to Australia's millennium drought. This drought lasted from the late 1990s to 2010. By the time it <u>ⓒ ended</u>, 40 percent of the city's 77,000 trees were in a state of <u>ⓓ declining</u> health. Furthermore, the overall number of trees <u>ⓔ were decreasing</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 게다가, 나무의 전체 수가 줄어들고 있었다. 주어 the overall number(단수)에 were(복수)가 쓰여 수일치 오류입니다. the number of + 복수명사는 항상 단수 취급하므로 was가 와야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: Furthermore, the overall number of trees were decreasing.
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: As a result, the amount of shade (A) <u>[provided / providing]</u> by trees within the city, also known as canopy cover, decreased. The loss of canopy cover is a major threat to urban environments because it raises temperatures. Higher temperatures in cities can be dangerous for residents, as they increase the risk of heat exhaustion. They also lead to a rise in the use of air conditioning. This speeds up climate change by (B) <u>[increasing / increased]</u> energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. Something had to (C) <u>[be done / do]</u> to deal with the loss of Melbourne's trees.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: (A) 나무에 의해 제공되는 그늘 — shade와 provide는 수동 관계 → 과거분사 provided. (B) 전치사 by 뒤 동명사 increasing. (C) Something(사물주어)이 행해지다 → 수동 be done.
det.analysis: 원문: (A) shade provided by trees (B) by increasing energy consumption (C) Something had to be done
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: This interactive map shows the location of every single tree in the city's parks and along its roads. It uses colors and symbols <u>ⓐ to indicate</u> each tree's age and genus. Also, users can click on a tree <u>ⓑ to find out</u> its species and even send it an email. At first, the "Email this tree" function had a specific purpose. It was designed <u>ⓒ to allow</u> people to easily inform council workers about trees <u>ⓓ that was damaged</u> or in poor health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 손상되었거나 건강이 좋지 않은 나무들. 선행사 trees(복수) → 관계대명사절 동사도 복수형 were가 와야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: trees that was damaged or in poor health
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

Without collective action from people across the globe, we would have little hope of (C) <u>[saving / wasting]</u> our planet for future generations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 자연과 연결됨 + 지속 가능한 세계 + 지구를 구함 — 모두 긍정적 메시지.
det.analysis: 원문: we are all connected to nature / building a more sustainable world / saving our planet for future generations
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: After the map was posted online, something ① <u>unexpected</u> happened. The trees started receiving thousands of emails, but many of them were not reports about damage or poor health. Instead, they were love letters, poems, greetings, and messages ② <u>expressing</u> appreciation for the trees. The tree mail phenomenon quickly ③ <u>spread</u>, and people all over the world started sending messages. The global popularity of the tree mail phenomenon ④ <u>reminds</u> us that we are all connected to nature, and we are all involved in building a more ⑤ <u>temporary</u> world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 원문은 sustainable(지속 가능한)이어야 하지만 temporary(일시적인)로 바뀌어 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.
det.analysis: 원문: building a more sustainable world → ⑤에 temporary(일시적인) 사용.
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: The loss of canopy cover is a major ① <u>threat</u> to urban environments because it raises temperatures. Higher temperatures in cities can be ② <u>dangerous</u> for residents, as they increase the ③ <u>risk</u> of heat exhaustion. They also lead to a rise in the use of air conditioning. This speeds up climate change by increasing energy ④ <u>conservation</u> and greenhouse gas emissions. Something had to be done to deal with the ⑤ <u>loss</u> of Melbourne's trees.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 에너지 소비와 온실가스 배출을 증가시킴으로써. 원문은 consumption(소비)이지만 ④에 conservation(보존)이 사용되어 인과관계가 성립하지 않습니다.
det.analysis: 원문: by increasing energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 올바른 형태로 고쳐 쓰시오.

Melbourne's urban forest strategy will help keep the city cool. It will also allow residents (interact) with nature and engage in outdoor activities every day.

det.korean: 주민들이 자연과 교류하게 해줄 것이다. allow + O + to-v 구문.
det.analysis: 원문: allow residents to interact with nature
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
